justification: Vulnerability scanner flags this Go standard library advisory against the FIPS 140-3 boringcrypto build variant; the scanner does not yet recognize the boringcrypto suffix on the toolchain/module version string, producing a false-positive FAIL. Exempted pending scanner support for the suffix. See .release/security-scan.hcl suppress.vulnerabilities.
